purpose: Seal the additive source-only repair of every M2146 finding without executing ICC2, querying a license, or authorizing M2155.

repairs.p0_startup_scope: exact wrapper invocation includes -no_init and isolated HOME/TMPDIR/XDG/local cache/cwd under env -i
repairs.p1_parser_semantics: exact gate values, frozen union94 name equality, nonempty native-binary NDM/design library and legal object facts
repairs.p1_process_census: PID/starttime identities, observed parents, exec transitions, summary/list equality, actual dgcom_exec plus isolated environment
repairs.p1_process_classifier: recognizes wrapper, icc2_exec, dgcom_exec, lm_shell_exec, icc2_lm_shell_exec, and other installed child names
repairs.p1_root_inventory: all immediate node types rather than regular files only
repairs.p1_receipt: selfchecks use -B/-I and this directory contains no pycache
repairs.p2_real_exec: wrapper and resolved 1.7-GB dgcom_exec are both SHA-pinned before launch
repairs.p2_core: one exact site named core; no wildcard fallback
repairs.p2_home: isolated HOME is created and checked in the actual executable environment
